capabilities.direct_trigger: Run an end-to-end non-trivial repository workflow.
capabilities.negative_trigger: A single bounded specialist outcome can be invoked directly.
capabilities.owner: authority, lifecycle, packet state, routing, integration, drift

capabilities.direct_trigger: Establish repository facts, current behavior, ECR, or EQAC.
capabilities.negative_trigger: The request is self-contained and has no repository dependency.
capabilities.owner: roots, instructions, facts, current behavior, readiness discovery

capabilities.direct_trigger: Create, change, explain, diff, promote, retire, waive, or audit profile assets.
capabilities.negative_trigger: Ordinary task only consumes an existing effective snapshot.
capabilities.owner: profile lifecycle and concise instruction projection

capabilities.direct_trigger: Resolve material semantics, design, scope, or approval.
capabilities.negative_trigger: Clear micro work has no material alternative or contract change.
capabilities.owner: user-owned semantics, acceptance, complete scope, approval

capabilities.direct_trigger: Establish product position, IA, flows, states, accessibility, or design truth.
capabilities.owner: product and UX intent plus UX Ready

capabilities.direct_trigger: Make a material language-native architecture or boundary choice.
capabilities.negative_trigger: Existing sound architecture resolves the bounded implementation without a material choice.

capabilities.direct_trigger: Select or change a dependency, tool, plugin, service, generator, runtime, or feature.
capabilities.negative_trigger: No manifest, graph, tool, service, or dependency capability changes.
capabilities.owner: current candidate comparison, named approval, graph and rollback

capabilities.direct_trigger: Reproduce and diagnose a bug, failure, flake, crash, hang, or anomaly.
capabilities.negative_trigger: The task has no incorrect behavior or causal uncertainty.
capabilities.owner: reproduction, hypotheses, root cause, regression proof

capabilities.direct_trigger: Plan or execute tests and fresh evidence.
capabilities.negative_trigger: No product or repository claim requires verification.

capabilities.direct_trigger: Independently review a frozen intent and change.
capabilities.negative_trigger: No change/diff or risk requires review.
capabilities.owner: blue/red review, finding verification, repair disposition

capabilities.direct_trigger: Assess acceptance, release, rollback, or delivery eligibility.
capabilities.negative_trigger: The task is pure discovery with no implementation or delivery claim.
capabilities.owner: claim state, changed files, compatibility, rollback, delivery authority

capabilities.direct_trigger: Explicitly maintain the Dev Flow suite itself.
capabilities.negative_trigger: Any ordinary product or repository task.
capabilities.owner: schemas, resolver, routing, hooks, migrations, governance, evaluations
